High-level plan (we'll attach a short ops playbook in the next email):
1) Trigger detection: platform reports monthly usage versus committed baseline; carveout applies when temporary one-off credits are applied to usage outside core buckets (we'll define list).
2) Billing application: offsets are applied at invoice generation as a line-item credit; if offsets exceed monthly invoice, remainder carries to next invoice for up to 90 days (policy in redline).

Hi all — thanks, Dylan and Sarah. I've attached the marked-up order form (GTS_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf) with suggested edits to Exhibit P. Quick summary of the legal changes and rationale: 

1) Clarified trigger language
- Replaced 'when eligible credits occur' with 'when a documented, one-time offset event, as defined in Section P.1, results in billable usage outside the committed baseline for the applicable billing month.'
- Rationale: removes ambiguity about what constitutes an offset event and ties it to a defined list.

2) Carry-forward mechanics
- Added explicit 90-day carry-forward window for credit application and a waterfall: (a) current invoice, (b) next invoice(s) up to 90 days, (c) year-end reconciliation.
- Rationale: gives Clear AR handling steps for accounting teams.

3) Cap on cumulative offsets
- Proposed a cumulative cap equal to three months of average committed spend to avoid indefinite liability exposure. If Greentech prefers a different cap, we can table it to the CFO conversation.

4) Escrow/carveout note
- If Greentech insists on segregated escrow for offset funds, we added a carveout clause requiring written notice 30 days prior to commencement and separate escrow agreement. This preserves Redwood's standard billing flow unless escrow is activated.

5) Minor drafting: changed 'credit' to 'invoice credit' where appropriate; added definitions for 'committed baseline', 'offset event', and 'carry-forward window'.

Operationally, Karthik — please confirm the invoicing flow below matches platform capability:
- System flags offset event -> accounting posts preliminary credit memo -> invoice generator applies credit as line-item -> other credits net against AR per policy -> any remaining un-applied credits appear on next invoice up to 90 days.

Sarah — once you confirm the carry window and whether escrow is required, we can (A) finalize the redline and (B) produce a short ops playbook (1 page) for your finance team.
